arms.ALIGNED_RECURSION: same z0; update exact trained F sequentially on causally observed transitions in authenticated order; expose current z at matched G sites
arms.BAGGED_TRANSITIONS: same correct target z0, trained F, shared G and matched exposure sites. At exposure t, independently compute u_i=unit_l2(F(z0,x_i)) for every observed target transition i<=t, then expose unit_l2(sum_i u_i). This consumes the same transition multiset and one F evaluation per transition but is exactly order-insensitive and has no transition-to-transition recurrent state path.
arms.DONOR_Z0_RECURSION: same trained recurrent F/G and exact target post-reset transitions/count/timing as ALIGNED_RECURSION, but z0 is W0(h_pre_reset) from one prospectively hash-selected different same-phase graph family. Donor identity is frozen from structure-only identifiers before any endpoint/outcome access; no evaluator A/B label or outcome may influence donor selection.
arms.LAST_TRANSITION_ONLY: same correct target z0, trained F, shared G and matched G exposure sites as ALIGNED_RECURSION. At each exposure after transition t, state is recomputed as unit_l2(F(z0,x_t)) from only the chronologically latest observed target transition; earlier post-reset transitions cannot enter the state. One F evaluation is attributed to each observed transition, matching the per-transition update budget without recurrent carry.
arms.MATCHED_INFORMATION: same z0/F/G/count/timing, but each transition input is replaced by a precommitted in-distribution same-operator donor transition from a different source graph selected by hash before outcomes; preserves feature realism/information volume while removing target-family transition identity
arms.STATIC_ONESHOT: redundant diagnostic: expose trained z0 at the final branch scoring site only; no F update; never a DEVELOPMENT gate
arms.STATIC_PREDICTIVE_SHARED_G: objective-matched static predictor using only h_pre_reset: S(h)=unit_l2(Linear512to256(tanh(Linear512to512(tanh(Linear2048to512(h)))))). The static state is repeated at every matched G site, receives no post-reset transition input, and uses the exact same tied Wa/action projection and bounded gain-1 G as the recurrent branch. Static encoder has 1,443,072 trainable state parameters versus 1,443,328 recurrent-state parameters (W0+Wx+GRU), a difference of 256 (<0.018%).
arms.STATIC_REPEAT: same trained z0 exposed at every matched G site; execute F on isolated scratch using same inputs/count but scratch has no path to G
arms.TRANSITION_PERMUTED: same z0, transition multiset, F/G, update/exposure count and timing; after all required transitions have occurred, replay exact precommitted nonidentity order; only order differs
arms.ZERO_Z0_RECURSION: same trained recurrent F and exact same post-reset transition sequence, update count, G, candidate scores, and exposure sites as ALIGNED_RECURSION, but initialize recurrent state to the exact all-zero 256D vector. No pre-reset feature enters this arm. Zero state is permitted before the first GRU update; every post-update state is unit-normalized.

development_endpoint: Reuse exact orientation-invariant V4 branch-preference endpoint: R_g=LSE(A)-LSE(B); D_g=abs(R_g-R_NO_CARRY); C_static=D_ALIGNED-D_STATIC_REPEAT; C_permuted=D_ALIGNED-D_TRANSITION_PERMUTED; C_information=D_ALIGNED-D_MATCHED_INFORMATION.

development_gates.multiplicity: Conjunctive intersection-union gate: every listed requirement must pass; no endpoint or control can rescue failure of another. Positive declaration is therefore not created by choosing among controls.
